evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, recorder.append is called after subprocess.Popen but before the try block. If the record write raises, boot() exits without reaching the except/finally cleanup, so process.terminate()/wait(), the scope stop attempt, and log.close() are all skipped and the spawned systemd-run/QEMU child can survive the failed launch. Putting the recorder.append inside the existing try block is the smallest compatible fix and does not require owner judgment.
